pages.quiz:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is a good manner when interviewing an elder about culture? (1 mark)
   A. Greeting politely and asking permission to record
   B. Laughing
   C. Interrupting
   D. Refusing to listen

2. How many county governments are there in Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. 47
   B. 27
   C. 57
   D. 37

3. Which resource gives electric power from underground steam at Olkaria? (1 mark)
   A. Oil
   B. Geothermal heat
   C. Wind
   D. Coal

4. What are tally marks used for? (1 mark)
   A. Measuring rain
   B. Counting votes
   C. Cooking
   D. Painting

5. A county is divided into smaller parts called what? (1 mark)
   A. Oceans
   B. Countries
   C. Sub-counties
   D. Continents

6. Which is a reason why many people live in towns? (1 mark)
   A. Jobs, shops and services
   B. No water
   C. No schools
   D. No roads

7. Which artefacts are carved at Kisii and sold to visitors? (1 mark)
   A. Glass windows
   B. Soapstone carvings
   C. Plastic toys
   D. Iron bridges

8. Who built Fort Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Nobody built it
   B. The Kenyan government in 1990
   C. The British in 1950
   D. The Portuguese

9. Which sentence helps you remember the cardinal points in clockwise order? (1 mark)
   A. Watch Every Sunny Night
   B. Some Old Men Walk
   C. Eat Slowly Now Wisely
   D. Never Eat Slimy Worms

10. Why should a weather chart be filled in at the same time each day? (1 mark)
   A. So that the chart looks big
   B. So that the sun rises earlier
   C. So that rain stops
   D. So that the records can be compared fairly

11. Which pattern describes houses standing close together around a trading centre? (1 mark)
   A. Linear
   B. Clustered
   C. Scattered
   D. Empty

12. What is a cost? (1 mark)
   A. Profit
   B. Money spent on the project
   C. Money received
   D. Salary

13. What might happen if all drivers stopped working? (1 mark)
   A. Schools would close forever
   B. Food and medicine could not reach shops and hospitals
   C. Nothing would change
   D. More crops would grow

14. Who should handle sharp tools in a school project? (1 mark)
   A. A young child alone
   B. A visitor
   C. Nobody
   D. An adult

15. What should you do if something online makes you feel scared? (1 mark)
   A. Keep it secret
   B. Meet the stranger
   C. Tell a trusted adult
   D. Reply angrily

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain why traditional culture is important. (3 marks)

17. Write a short poem of four lines about the benefits of industries in your county. (5 marks)

18. State three industries found in Kenya and the raw material each uses. (3 marks)

19. Explain the difference between a ceremony and a festival and give one example of each. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Greeting politely and asking permission to record
   Politeness shows respect.

2. A — 47
   There are 47 counties, each with its own government.

3. B — Geothermal heat
   Olkaria makes electricity from geothermal steam.

4. B — Counting votes
   Tally marks help count votes.

5. C — Sub-counties
   Counties are divided into sub-counties, and sub-counties into wards.

6. A — Jobs, shops and services
   Towns offer work and services.

7. B — Soapstone carvings
   Kisii is known for soapstone carving.

8. D — The Portuguese
   The Portuguese built the fort more than 400 years ago.

9. D — Never Eat Slimy Worms
   The first letters N, E, S, W give north, east, south, west in clockwise order.

10. D — So that the records can be compared fairly
   Observing at the same time gives fair comparisons.

11. B — Clustered
   Clustered means close together in a group.

12. B — Money spent on the project
   Costs are expenses.

13. B — Food and medicine could not reach shops and hospitals
   Transport connects producers, shops and hospitals.

14. D — An adult
   Adults must handle dangerous tools.

15. C — Tell a trusted adult
   A trusted adult can help.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: It gives identity, teaches values, and brings people together.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

17. (5 marks)
   Answer: A poem that mentions jobs, income and goods, is neat and rhymes or has rhythm.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for four lines, 1 mark for jobs, 1 mark for income or goods, 1 mark for a title, 1 mark for correct language.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Sugar factory uses sugarcane, tea factory uses tea leaves, cement factory uses limestone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each industry with its material.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: A ceremony marks a special event in life, such as a wedding. A festival is a big celebration with many people, such as the Lamu Cultural Festival.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meaning and 1 mark for each example.
